# Mixed-Integer Programming {#sec-mip}

<!-- LIVE hands-on (MILP/MIQP on HiGHS, install-free) + MI-SOCP DEMO via scip.

::: callout-note
## What you'll be able to do
Add integer or boolean variables to a model and solve it with HiGHS (MILP/MIQP).
See a mixed-integer second-order-cone problem solved with SCIP.
:::

::: callout-important
## Chapter under construction (Phase 2)
Hands-on MILP/MIQP runs on HiGHS (a CVXR import). The MI-SOCP showcase uses
`scip` and is run as a demo (CRAN-reproducible at home).
See [Mixed-Integer QP](https://cvxr.rbind.io/examples/basic/miqp.html).
:::
